name: Chastity
overview: Scripture presents chastity as a vital expression of holiness and obedience to God, exemplified by Joseph's steadfast refusal to sin against God despite temptation from his master's wife. The commandment against adultery underscores the moral imperative to maintain purity in relationships. Ruth's respectful and obedient behavior further illustrates the virtue of chastity in action, demonstrating faithfulness and honor within God's design for human conduct.
